identities.note: One economic fact under two captions; see the equivalence blocks.
Holds only under the negative-expense sign convention.
The primary guard against the wrapped-caption confusion between the two bottom lines.

The three terms are the CLOSING subtotal of each activity section, spelled as the template declares them. Earlier revisions wrote them as the shorthand net_operating/net_investing/net_financing, which the template has never declared, so this blocking identity resolved to nothing and stayed skipped on every filing.
A break here is usually restricted cash or pledged deposits wrongly swept into cash and cash equivalents, or an overdraft presented within cash.

An independent route to net assets: the ladder reaches it through net current assets, this reaches it through total assets, so a figure double-counted between the two sections breaks one and not the other. The equity attribution and the reserves composition are NOT here — the revised rollups on bs_equity__total_equity and bs_equity__reserves already assert exactly those two sums.

The other half of the spec's COALESCE_MATCHED: this pairs with cf_pbt_agreement, and because a cash flow starts from one line or the other, exactly one of the two ever has both operands and runs. Comparing the cash flow's starting profit against the WRONG P&L line would fail by the tax charge on every correct filing.

Restates the new rollup so the composition carries the spec's severity: a filing whose two IAS 1 categories disagree with the printed subtotal has a classification difference worth a look, not a broken statement. Skips when either side is absent.

The tax charge added back in the cash flow is the tax charge in profit or loss, with the sign reversed because expenses are stored negative. Skips on a cash flow that starts after tax, where there is no add-back to compare.

Depreciation and amortisation added back in the cash flow against the charge in profit or loss. The spec asks for a 0.5% tolerance, which an identity cannot carry, so this runs on the shared tolerance: a small break here is usually depreciation capitalised into inventory or a development asset rather than an extraction error.

Finance costs added back in the cash flow against interest expense in profit or loss. The spec marks this advisory with a 2% tolerance; the severity enum has no advisory level and an identity carries no tolerance, so it is a warning — capitalised interest causes a legitimate variance and a break here is a question, not a defect.

cross_concept_guards.rule: A concept whose sign_convention is positive_expected or negative_expected carrying the opposite sign.
bs_non_current_assets__investments_in_subsidiaries populated on a column resolved as consolidated.
bs_equity__reserves populated together with any of its listed components.
pl_exceptional_items__share_of_profit_of_associates_and_jvs populated together with either separate share line.
pl_profit_for_the_year equal to pl_total_comprehensive_income_for_the_year while pl_other_comprehensive_income_for_the_year is non-zero.
bs_equity__non_controlling_interests equal to pl_profit_attributable_to__non_controlling_interests — almost always the balance-versus-flow confusion.

section_reconciliation: Every section with a reported subtotal must satisfy the residual_framework reconciliation identity. Failure emits unallocated_gap and blocks auto-approval of that section.
